steps: From the initialized official blank template with zero documents/assets/registrations, create and ordinarily save the first definition through Studio.

Create the exact official retry TXT and first behavior through Studio. Its saved parameters start empty. Explicit Add missing supplies exactly three String defaults; preview and Cancel leave every saved author byte unchanged.

stages.name: UI first behavior creation with empty parameters

limitations: The harness initializes the official blank template layout with one generic document type and zero authored documents/assets/registrations. It does not automate desktop-library project creation, native folder pickers, installed Tauri or Android.

Every definition, two scenes, official retry TXT, empty-parameter behavior, input map, assembly and HUD is subsequently created through actual Studio controls; no prepared game source, scene UUID or behavior metadata is injected.
Default rows and named choices remain ordinary scalar parameters. Reading and selecting do not save; Add missing and Insert are explicit, followed by ordinary Check/Apply/Save.

The retained author-final workspace and frozen plan enable a separate actual Godot keyboard/HUD check. This browser report does not claim native gameplay, same-scene restart or independent distribution.
